title: Key information relating to cash dividend for third quarter 2026
summary: Key information relating to the cash dividend to be paid by Equinor ASA for third quarter 2026.
body_markdown:
Key information relating to the cash dividend to be paid by Equinor ASA for third quarter 2026.


Cash dividend amount: 0.39


Announced currency: USD


Last day including rights: 12 February 2027


Ex-date Oslo Børs: 15 February 2027


Ex-date New York Stock Exchange: 16 February 2027


Record date: 16 February 2027


Payment date: 26 February 2027


Date of approval: 27 October 2026


Other information: The cash dividend per share in NOK will be communicated on 22 February 2027.


*This information is published in accordance with the requirements of the Continuing Obligations and is subject to the disclosure requirements pursuant to Section 5-12 in the Norwegian Securities Trading Act.*
